scope: Explicit test agent. All complete tickServer calls (normal or exceptional) in this window, including Neo Pre/Post; fixed bounded histograms, not rolling samples. Named nested method spans are inclusive/exclusive, not all summed. No game objects or file IO on server-thread probe callbacks.

clock.mapping_limit: Same-host shared OS realtime anchors, 1ms quantization plus observed drift. Never subtract raw nanoTime from different JVMs.

histogram_precision: Upper bounds, <=3.125% width above32ns; count/sum/max exact; each window is bounded to180000 ticks.
limits: Methods crossing window cutoffs/exceptional returns are not backend latency observations. Server/runtime samples include all completed instrumented calls; exceptional returns are separately counted. Calls crossing the cutoffs are excluded. Heap/GC/SQL asset counters are measured separately. Tracing copies identifiers/amounts only on the original calling thread.
